content.short: Suilend STEAMM is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless decentralized exchanges within the Web3 ecosystem on Sui.
content.description: Steamm is an advanced automated market maker (AMM) and liquidity hub built on the Sui blockchain by the Suilend team. Operating at the forefront of the DeFi Dapps sector, Suilend STEAMM redefines how users interact with decentralized exchanges. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Sui to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Suilend STEAMM stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
